HINT_APP_PURPOSE_BODY:
Focus Tiger is a mindful companion for focus and presence — a quiet place for practice, at your own pace.

No pressure, no ads. Practice stays on this device. We don’t mine your reflections.

Across a day, Yin can meet you in five gentle moments: Arrive → Focus → Recover → Transition → Reflect.
FIVE_MOMENTS_CARD_BLURB: Focus Tiger isn’t only a timer. It’s five gentle companions across a day: Arrive → Focus → Recover → Transition → Reflect.
CONFIDE_PANEL_BLURB: Say what’s on your mind. Yin listens — short, quiet replies. Nothing leaves this device.
JOURNEY_LOG_CARD_BLURB: Quiet traces of sittings on this device — not a score, not Health data.
JOURNEY_LOG_BACKUP_LINK_OFF: Bind email for optional cloud backup
JOURNEY_LOG_BACKUP_PRIVACY: Optional. We upload only your practice trail on this device (journey, practice days, milestones, ownership marks, rituals, mustard-seed seal) after you agree — quietly, not while you sit. Not a promise that data can never be lost. You can turn off anytime; that deletes the cloud copy.
JOURNEY_LOG_BACKUP_CONSENT: I agree to back up these practice traces to Focus Tiger’s cloud.
JOURNEY_LOG_BACKUP_STATUS_ERR: Something went wrong. Local records are unchanged.

PRIVACY_SHEET_INTRO: We do not sell your data. We do not use your focus intentions or reflections for ads or personality scoring. v1.0.0 is built to work on your device — core practice does not require an account or cloud AI. No ads in this practice space.
PRIVACY_SHEET_ON_DEVICE: What typically stays on your device: preferences (reminder, hints seen, language), ambient music you upload (this browser’s IndexedDB only), and limited recent session or reflection snippets needed for continuity — not mined for psychology.
PRIVACY_SHEET_NOT_DO: What we do not do in v1.0.0: no account login for the core loop; no cloud sync of your practice by default; no crash SDK and no analytics by default (optional anonymous support-funnel counts only if you turn them on below). We do not promise any named cloud vault sync in v1.
PRIVACY_SHEET_CLOUD: If we add cloud features later, we will explain what is sent, why, how long it is kept, and ask for consent before it leaves your device.
PRIVACY_SHEET_CLOSING: Use ? for a short introduction to this space. This sheet is the fuller plain-language privacy note.
PRIVACY_SHEET_FUNNEL_OPT_IN_HINT: Off by default. If you turn this on, we send only Support → checkout step counts (no email, no reflections, no payment IDs) to our own server so we can improve the quiet support path. You can turn it off anytime.
